summary: You can think and live on your own terms when you reach for it. The originality is there, switched on when you use it. It rewards you for stepping off the path.
body: You can think and live on your own terms when you reach for it. The originality is there, switched on when you use it. It rewards you for stepping off the path. Left idle, you blend in and follow the script. But when you choose to back your own ideas, to do the thing your way, doors open that conformity never finds. The opening pays out when you take it. Reach for it and you stop waiting for permission to be yourself.
gift: At your best: original and independent once you decide to use it.
shadow: The trap: blending in and following the script when you could step off it.
integration: Let identity and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
do: Do it your way on purpose
Step off the path when it's gone stale
dont: Wait for permission to be yourself
